recognize_zh: 大型原始細胞有圓或略呈腎形的核、細緻染色質，以及量多的灰藍色細胞質帶細小空泡，外觀很像單核母細胞（monoblasts）；但本題歸類於前驅淋巴腫瘤，提醒這種「細胞質豐富」的 ALL 易被誤認為 AMoL，必須以流式或細胞化學確認。
features: Large blasts with abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm
Round to slightly reniform nuclei with finely granular, dispersed chromatin
Fine cytoplasmic vacuoles in several cells; no Auer rods or distinct granules
Background of small mature lymphocytes and a few neutrophil precursors
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows large blasts with round to slightly reniform nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small or inconspicuous nucleoli and abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine vacuoles. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are not identified, and small mature lymphocytes are scattered in the background. The abundant cytoplasm and vacuolation mimic monoblasts, although the case is classified under precursor lymphoid neoplasms. Morphology cannot assign lineage here; flow cytometry, TdT and nonspecific esterase/MPO cytochemistry are needed to distinguish B-lymphoblastic leukemia from acute monoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts are nonspecific esterase positive and CD14/CD64/CD11b/lysozyme positive, whereas lymphoblasts are TdT, CD19, CD10 or cCD3 positive and esterase negative.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles and a mature CD20+/sIg+ TdT-negative phenotype with MYC rearrangement.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei, a perinuclear hof and deeper basophilic cytoplasm and express CD138/CD38 with light chain restriction.
